bollinger_reversion.description: Long from a close below the lower band until a close above the middle band.

donchian_breakout.description: Long from a close above the n_in-bar high until a close below the n_out-bar low.

gtaa_faber.description:
Hold from a month's turn at which the close is above the average of the last `months` month-turn closes until a
    turn at which it is not (a month's turn: its first close, `period_starts`).

ibs.description: Long from a close near the bar's low (IBS < buy_below) until a close near its high (IBS > sell_above).

ml_feature_search.description:
Long while LightGBM on the chosen indicator families gives a rise in HORIZON bars a probability above
    `threshold`; unless long only, short while it gives it less than 1 - `threshold`.

rsi2_ml_filter.description:
RSI(2)'s trades (long on RSI(2) < rsi_entry above the 200-day SMA until a close above the 5-bar SMA) that the
    model gives a probability above `threshold` of making money after costs.

rsi2_ml_sized.description:
RSI(2)'s trades (long on RSI(2) < rsi_entry above the 200-day SMA until a close above the 5-bar SMA), each
    scaled by the model's confidence.
